content:
FINAL IVX PRODUCTION CLOSEOUT — EXECUTE NOW, DO NOT RETURN A REPORT-ONLY RESPONSE

Current reported status:
- Production deployment: VERIFIED
- GitHub HEAD and Render commit match
- /health: HTTP 200
- Migrations: 11/11 applied, 0 failures
- Database audit: 12/12 module areas present
- Authentication: 9/10 passed
- Autonomous worker: RUNNING
- APK: v1.4.6 build 38

This task is to close every remaining item with direct, verifiable evidence.

==================================================
1. CLOSE THE PASSWORD-RESET FAILURE
==================================================

Current blocker:
Supabase SMTP returns HTTP 429 rate limit.

Complete one of these production-safe solutions:

A. Configure a dedicated production SMTP provider in Supabase.
B. Correct the existing SMTP quota or rate-limit configuration.
C. Implement a secure owner recovery fallback using verified SMS OTP.

Requirements:
- Do not bypass identity verification.
- Do not disable security controls.
- Test with the real owner account.
- Confirm delivery.
- Confirm reset link or OTP works.
- Set a new password.
- Login with the new password.
- Confirm the old password is rejected.
- Record timestamps and trace IDs.

Required result:
PASSWORD RESET = VERIFIED

==================================================
2. PHYSICAL-DEVICE AUTHENTICATION QA
==================================================

Test the same production build on:

- Android physical device
- iPhone physical device
- Production web

Test each platform independently:

1. Fresh installation or cleared session
2. Manual owner email/password login
3. Invalid password rejection
4. Non-owner authorization rejection
5. Owner Dashboard access
6. Admin Hub access
7. Settings access
8. Variables access
9. Members access
10. Investors access
11. Deals access
12. Reels access
13. Messages and IVX AI Chat access
14. Logout
15. Login again
16. Force-close the app
17. Reopen the app
18. Confirm session persistence
19. Refresh expired token
20. Confirm no infinite loading or blank screen

Capture:
- Full-screen screenshots
- Screen recordings
- Platform and OS version
- Test timestamp
- Build version
- Commit SHA
- Result for every step

Required result:
ANDROID AUTH = VERIFIED
IPHONE AUTH = VERIFIED
WEB AUTH = VERIFIED

==================================================
3. APK DELIVERY AND INSTALLATION PROOF
==================================================

Provide the actual installable artifact.

Required:
- Direct APK download URL
- Exact filename
- Version: v1.4.6
- Build: 38 or a newer verified build
- File size
- SHA-256 checksum
- EAS build ID
- Build profile
- Build timestamp
- Source commit SHA
- Package/application ID
- Signing status

Install the APK on a clean Android device and prove:

- Installation completes successfully
- App launches
- No crash at startup
- Owner login works
- Members load
- Investors load
- Deals load
- Reels load
- Chat keyboard works
- Logout and session persistence work

Do not provide only an EAS dashboard page.
Provide the actual downloadable APK.

==================================================
4. PRODUCTION DATA VALIDATION
==================================================

Do not only verify that tables exist.

Validate real production records for:

- Members
- Investors
- Buyers
- Properties
- Deals
- Reels
- Messages
- Media
- Documents
- Transactions
- Owner Settings
- Variables

For every module provide:

- Table name
- Current row count
- Active row count
- Archived/deleted row count
- Latest record timestamp
- API endpoint tested
- HTTP response code
- UI screen where the records appear
- Mobile result
- Web result
- Any discrepancy found

Confirm specifically:

- Real members are visible in the application
- Investors are visible
- Buyers are visible
- Existing investment cards are restored
- Reels are visible on landing and in the Reels module
- Messages persist after restart
- No fake placeholder data is being displayed

Required result:
DATA PRESENCE AND UI SYNC = VERIFIED

==================================================
5. FULL MODULE SMOKE TEST
==================================================

Run a production smoke test for every major IVX route and module.

Public:
- Landing page
- Registration
- Login
- Password recovery
- Deals
- Investment cards
- Reels
- Media playback
- Contact/submission forms

Owner:
- Owner Dashboard
- Admin Hub
- Members
- Investors
- Buyers
- Properties
- Deals
- Reels administration
- Messages
- IVX AI Chat
- Documents
- Transactions
- Revenue
- Settings
- Variables
- Autonomous Dashboard
- QA/Diagnostics

For every route provide:

- Route or URL
- HTTP status
- Load time
- UI result
- API result
- Console error count
- Server error count
- Screenshot
- PASS or FAIL

Fix every failure before final closeout.

==================================================
6. CHAT AND REELS FINAL QA
==================================================

IVX AI Chat:
- Keyboard opens correctly
- Composer remains visible
- Messages send once
- No duplicate messages
- Correct ordering
- Messages persist after app restart
- Scroll-to-latest works
- Attachments work
- Errors show trace ID
- Owner can see autonomous reports

Reels:
- Reels open without crashing
- Swipe does not cause jumping
- Video does not restart unexpectedly
- Like/comment/share controls work
- Correct deal is associated with each reel
- Landing page reels match the Reels module
- Images and videos are not mixed between properties
- Android and iPhone behave consistently

Required result:
CHAT = VERIFIED
REELS = VERIFIED

==================================================
7. DEPLOYMENT TRACEABILITY
==================================================

Provide one immutable production evidence set containing:

- GitHub repository
- Branch
- GitHub HEAD SHA
- Render service
- Render deployment ID
- Render deployment timestamp
- Live production SHA
- API build version
- APK source SHA
- EAS build ID
- Database migration version
- Boot timestamp

Confirm these relationships:

GitHub HEAD = Render deployed commit
Render deployed commit = /health commit
/health commit = APK source commit
Migration version = migration files in that commit

Any mismatch must be fixed before closure.

==================================================
8. SECURITY CLEANUP
==================================================

The Supabase Management API token was pasted into chat.

Complete the following:

- Rotate the exposed token
- Replace it in Render securely
- Confirm the old token is revoked
- Test the new token
- Confirm migrations still work
- Confirm autonomous checks still work
- Search code and logs for leaked secrets
- Remove any exposed credential from committed files
- Confirm owner-only access to Variables
- Confirm no secret is returned by public APIs
- Confirm production logs mask secrets

Do not display the full new token in the report.

Required result:
EXPOSED TOKEN ROTATED = VERIFIED
SECRET SCAN = CLEAN

==================================================
9. AUTONOMOUS WORKER FINAL VALIDATION
==================================================

Keep the autonomous worker running and prove:

- Health check every 5 minutes
- Authentication check every 15 minutes
- Full system audit every 2 hours
- Incident creation works
- Auto-remediation works
- Failed remediation escalates to owner
- Reports appear in IVX AI Chat
- Every report includes timestamps and evidence
- Duplicate incidents are prevented
- Workers survive a Render restart

Run one controlled non-destructive test incident.

Required proof:
1. Incident detected
2. Incident opened
3. Remediation executed
4. Service re-tested
5. Incident closed
6. Owner report delivered

Required result:
AUTONOMOUS INCIDENT LOOP = VERIFIED

==================================================
10. FINAL ACCEPTANCE GATE
==================================================

Do not declare completion until all items below are green:

[ ] Password reset verified
[ ] Android physical-device QA passed
[ ] iPhone physical-device QA passed
[ ] Web QA passed
[ ] Direct APK delivered
[ ] APK installed successfully
[ ] Production data visible in UI
[ ] Members verified
[ ] Investors verified
[ ] Buyers verified
[ ] Deals verified
[ ] Reels verified
[ ] Chat verified
[ ] GitHub/Render/API/APK commits matched
[ ] Exposed token rotated
[ ] Secret scan clean
[ ] Autonomous incident loop verified
[ ] Zero unresolved P0 issues
[ ] Zero unresolved P1 issues
[ ] Final evidence package delivered

==================================================
REQUIRED FINAL RESPONSE FORMAT
==================================================

Return only this structured closeout package:

FINAL IVX PRODUCTION CLOSEOUT

Overall status:
VERIFIED or NOT VERIFIED

1. GitHub repository:
2. Branch:
3. GitHub HEAD:
4. Render deployment ID:
5. Live API URL:
6. /health response:
7. APK direct download URL:
8. APK filename:
9. APK version/build:
10. APK SHA-256:
11. EAS build ID:
12. Android QA:
13. iPhone QA:
14. Web QA:
15. Password reset:
16. Members count and UI result:
17. Investors count and UI result:
18. Buyers count and UI result:
19. Deals result:
20. Reels result:
21. Chat result:
22. Migration result:
23. Token rotation result:
24. Secret scan result:
25. Autonomous incident-loop result:
26. Remaining P0 issues:
27. Remaining P1 issues:
28. Evidence links:
29. Final production decision:

Rules:
- Do not mark VERIFIED without evidence.
- Do not substitute narrative for screenshots, logs, IDs or URLs.
- Do not hide incomplete device testing.
- Do not close the task while any P0 or P1 issue remains.
- Do not ask for credentials unless a real runtime test returns missing, expired, revoked, 401 or 403.
- Use the existing stored credentials and production variables.
- Continue execution until the final acceptance gate is fully green.
